description: EasyRegistry hosts online gift registries for weddings, baby showers, birthdays and other special occasions. Without signing in, users can search public registries around an event date, view one registry's public details, and browse its available gifts. After signing in with OAuth, registry owners can list their registries, review gifts, contributions and totals, add a gift by describing it or by pasting a product link, update or remove a gift, and change registry settings such as the title, event date and location. Every owner tool is limited to registries the signed-in user owns. No tool moves money, refunds a payment or releases a payout, and contribution data is returned in a reduced, redacted form.
